title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Ten thousand Pesos for a Philippine Exhibit At the Taipeh, Formosa, Exhibition.

text.en:
The sum of ten thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby appropriated
out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the purpose of providing for a
Philippine exhibit at the exposition to be held at Taipeh, Formosa, April tenth to May ninth, nineteen hundred
and sixteen, under the auspices of the Government of Formosa; and the Governor-General is hereby
authorized to take such steps as' may be necessary to accomplish the purposes of this Act and to designate'
and fix the salaries of the necessary personnel: Provided, That not more than three persons shall be designated
for duty in Formosa and that they shall be selected, if possible, from the personnel that has been on duty with
the Philippine Exhibit at the Panama-Pacific Exposition.

The Governor-General shall present to the Legislature, within the first fifteen days of the session
immediately following the Taipeh Exposition, a detailed report of the exhibition above provided for, setting
forth all moneys received and disbursements made on account of the Philippine exhibit.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 24, 1916.
